Great question! 🌿

If you waited until the **26th**, the upgrade would apply to the **following month's box** instead of the next one.

- Your **Starter** box would already have been billed on the **25th**, and it would still ship in the first full week of the month.
- Your **Collector** plan would start with the box after that. You'd be charged the **$49** on the 25th of the following month.
- An already-billed box isn't refunded or changed, so you'd get one more Starter box first.

Since it's the 22nd, you still have time. If you switch before the 25th, you get your Collector box a month sooner. You can do it under **Account > Subscriptions**.

Is there anything else I can help with? Happy upgrading! 🌱
